registry.title: Reinsurance treaties
registry.lead: The excess-of-loss reinsurance contracts: year, period, placed percentage and status. Open a treaty for its layers, participations and recoverables.
registry.emptyBody: When a reinsurance treaty is entered it appears here.
registry.noResultsBody: Change or clear the status filter.

layers.title: Layers
layers.emptyBody: The treaty has no layers entered.

recoverables.title: Recoverables
recoverables.emptyBody: Recoverables appear when a claim reaches the layers of the treaty.
recoverables.partialTitle: Part of the recoverables is shown
recoverables.partialBody: There are more records than are loaded here; the totals are not complete.
recoverables.outstandingNote: Outstanding is a layer-year figure: total incurred minus total paid. It is not calculated per claim.
recoverables.allocatedNote: A reinsurer's outstanding is the layer outstanding allocated across the participants; it can differ by cents from incurred minus paid.
recoverables.perClaimNote: Per claim only the incurred and the paid recoverable are shown.
recoverables.invalid: Recovery data is inconsistent. Request a review before using these amounts.

terms.title: Terms
terms.interest: Statutory interest in ultimate net loss

decision.title: Approval
decision.confirmSubmitBody: After submission the treaty does not change until another manager approves or returns it.
decision.draftHelp: The treaty is a draft. It is submitted for approval by a reinsurance manager.
decision.draftReadOnly: The treaty is a draft and has not been submitted yet.
decision.pendingHelp: Entered by {maker}. Approve it, or return it with a reason.
decision.managerOnly: The treaty is waiting for approval by a reinsurance manager.
decision.unknownActorBody: Your authenticated actor identity or the maker identity is unavailable. This request remains read-only. Sign in again; the server requires a checker who did not enter or edit the treaty.
decision.sodTitle: You cannot approve your own entry
decision.sodBody: You entered this treaty. Another reinsurance manager must review it (separation of duties).
decision.reasonReturnHelp: Say what must be corrected; the treaty goes back to draft.
decision.reasonRequired: A reason is required to return the treaty.

final.APPROVED: Approved; it becomes active at the start of the period.

errors.title: The action failed
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.generic: The action did not complete. Try again.

codes.RI-ERR-SOD: You cannot approve a treaty you entered yourself. Ask another reinsurance manager to review it.
codes.RI-ERR-STATE: The treaty is no longer at the stage that expects this action. Reload the page.
codes.RI-ERR-STALE: Another user changed the treaty. Reload to see its current state.
codes.RI-ERR-VALIDATION: The details are not valid. Check the reason and try again.
codes.RI-ERR-SIGNED-LINES: The signed lines do not add up to the placed percentage, or there is not exactly one lead.
codes.RI-ERR-IDEMPOTENCY-MISMATCH: The request was repeated with different content. Reload and try again.

claim.title: Reinsurance recoverables of a claim
claim.emptyBody: The claim does not reach the layers of any active treaty, or has not been calculated yet.
claim.outstandingNote: Outstanding recoverable is not shown per claim; it is a layer-year figure shown on the treaty.

editor.confirmBody: The treaty is saved as a draft. Submit it afterwards for approval by a different user.
editor.organisationOnly: Select an organisation as the reinsurer
editor.role: A reinsurance accountant role is required
editor.draftOnly: Only draft treaties can be edited

validation.year: The year must be 1900 or later.
validation.period: The end must be after the start.
validation.signed: Signed lines must sum to the placed percentage (above 0 and up to 100).
validation.layers: Enter positive limits and nonnegative retention per layer.
validation.scope: Select at least one product coverage.
